query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `revenueRecords` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`recordDate` timestamp NOT NULL,
	`recordNumber` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
	`revenueType` enum('package_delivery','full_package_sale','full_package_commission','service_fee','extra_service','shipping_fee','other') NOT NULL,
	`amountUsd` decimal(12,2) NOT NULL,
	`amountIqd` decimal(15,0),
	`exchangeRate` decimal(10,2),
	`costUsd` decimal(12,2) DEFAULT '0',
	`profitUsd` decimal(12,2) DEFAULT '0',
	`referenceType` enum('package','fullPackageOrder','invoice','service','manual'),
	`referenceId` int,
	`customerId` int,
	`description` text,
	`status` enum('pending','confirmed','cancelled') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'confirmed',
	`createdById` int NOT NULL,
	`confirmedById` int,
	`createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
	`updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
	CONSTRAINT `revenueRecords_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`),
	CONSTRAINT `revenueRecords_recordNumber_unique` UNIQUE(`recordNumber`)
);
